text:
Carmen: kicking off the Artemis Labs silicon preview EAP. NDA is in place, partner shipping a 2-unit kit Tue morning. Quick sync on who owns what and the embargo cadence.
Derek: I'll pick up lab ops + run queue. Will reserve nodes and coordinate spares.
Carmen: thanks. @Sasha you own telemetry ingestion + secure key handoff. Ben owns the perf matrix and harness. Nate will track marketplace/marketing artifacts.
Ben: sketching the perf matrix now: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, VRAM peak, compile time, and power samples. I'll prepare a tiny harness that runs 200 itrs and emits CSV.
Sasha: telemetry notes: enable verbose hw counters for first 3 runs, collect KV-cache traces, seq_len hist, and cold-start traces. We'll push keys to vault and rotate after EAP.
Nate: partner asked for a marketplace tile draft and a checklist for compliance docs (SOC/ISO blurbs). Can someone get logo + brief product blurb from partner PM?
Carmen: embargo rule: no external mention until 2 business days after perf signoff and marketing copy approved by legal. We need partner signoff on quote before any screenshots go public.
eap-bot: NDA update: Artemis Labs NDA signed 2026-03-10 by both parties. Access token ART-EAP-5577 provisioned.
Derek: kit ETA Tue 08:45 PT. I've reserved node-7 and node-8 09:30-17:00 Tue/Wed. Prep image: rwi/inference-eap:artemis-202603. Ops confirmed spare fans and an extra PSU on standby.
Ben: bench run example: ```bash
./bench_runner --model artemis/quant-2 --batch 4 --seq 1024 --iters 200 --trace kv
```
Ben: sample line: `iter 150 | p50 9.8ms | p95 38.4ms | tokens/s 2150 | vram_peak 5.8GB | power 195W`
Sasha: FYI partner reported intermittent thermal throttling on unit B during internal soak. Ops: please monitor temps and set a shorter swap window. I'll enable hw-telemetry alerts.
Derek: noted. I'll set auto-throttle thresholds and a 30min hot-swap period. Run notes will be appended inline in this thread for ops runbook copy/paste.
Carmen: Tuesday checklist: 1) confirm kit physical QC, 2) boot image and runtime smoke, 3) telemetry keys in vault, 4) perf harness run matrix, 5) collect traces and upload to secure S3 path, 6) start internal signoff doc and notify legal/marketing.
Ben: adding a quick regression prompt set to detect quality blips from quant changes. If perf drops >12% vs baseline we halt and roll back compiler flags.
Nate: marketplace: I'll create a draft tile with features toggled off and placeholder copy. Need partner logo + 1 screenshot. Who will ask PM?
Sasha: pinged partner PM for logo and quote. They said logo + short blurb by EOD Monday, quote TBD. Also asked whether they'd prefer a joint webinar or partner-only demo during the embargo window.
Carmen: perfect. Also confirm telemetry retention: raw traces for 7 days, aggregated metrics to 90 days for quality monitors.
Sasha: confirmed retention and will add an anonymization pass before sharing with partner engineers.
Derek: small ops ask: please include the exact image tag and bench command in run notes. I'll paste into the runbook.
Carmen: image tag: `rwi/inference-eap:artemis-202603` bench command link will be posted after smoke. Runbook URL: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eap-artemis-1732105555 (I'll upload artifacts there).
Ben: if we see any reproducible regressions I'll snapshot logs and a minimal repro script that can be sent to partner under NDA.
Nate: marketing note: once we have approved screenshot + quote, I can prep a joint press boilerplate but will hold until legal signs off.
Carmen: reconvene Wed 17:00 PT for first-pass signoff and decide go/no-go for the 2-week joint announcement window. :thumbsup:
root_message: Carmen: kicking off the Artemis Labs silicon preview EAP. NDA is in place, partner shipping a 2-unit kit Tue morning. Quick sync on who owns what and the embargo cadence.
